messages.subject: Bosch Thailand | Industry 4.0, sustainability and external stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Bosch Thailand Leadership Team,

Bosch's Thailand platform, including manufacturing and R&D in Rayong, places the company at the center of automation, electrification, industrial transformation and sustainability. Those priorities align strongly with the environment in which I have built my leadership experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead country-facing engagement across government, regulators, communities and strategic partners while coordinating internally across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security, aviation and technical teams.

My strongest contribution to Bosch would sit between strategy and execution. I bring experience around large-scale solar and battery storage, carbon-data governance, complex regulatory processes, community and social-performance priorities, and executive issue management. This background has trained me to identify external risk early, create internal accountability and protect momentum on major industrial priorities.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN mandates in corporate affairs, sustainability, external relations, strategic partnerships or country strategy. I have attached a Bosch-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant leadership or talent team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
